title: Image Generation Engine
summary: This module provides the core logic for image generation, including command-line utilities for various models and an HTTP handler for image completion requests.

nodes.label: CLI Main Entrypoint
nodes.title: CLI Main Entrypoint
nodes.description: The primary command-line interface for the image generation engine, handling various flags for model selection, generation parameters, and utility functions.

nodes.label: Z-Image Model Generation
nodes.title: Z-Image Model Generation
nodes.description: Handles image generation specifically for Z-Image models, processing prompts and configuration to produce an image.

nodes.label: FLUX.2 Model Generation
nodes.title: FLUX.2 Model Generation
nodes.description: Manages image generation for FLUX.2 Klein models, including loading input images and applying generation configurations.

nodes.label: LLM Image Processing
nodes.title: LLM Image Processing
nodes.description: Processes image inputs for multimodal LLMs and orchestrates text generation with image context.

nodes.label: MLX Initialization
nodes.title: MLX Initialization
nodes.description: Initializes the MLX framework, setting up the necessary environment for GPU operations and restoring error handling.

nodes.label: HTTP Completion Handler
nodes.title: HTTP Completion Handler
nodes.description: An HTTP endpoint that receives image generation requests, decodes them, and dispatches them to the MLX thread for processing.

nodes.label: MLX Thread Executor
nodes.title: MLX Thread Executor
nodes.description: Executes MLX-related tasks in a dedicated thread to ensure proper GPU context management and prevent concurrency issues.

nodes.label: Image Saving Utility
nodes.title: Image Saving Utility
nodes.description: A utility function responsible for saving generated image arrays to specified output paths, typically in PNG format.

nodes.label: Model Loading Utility
nodes.title: Model Loading Utility
nodes.description: Loads various image generation models from specified paths, preparing them for inference.
